# `url_decode`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
url_decode(str)
```

Decodes a `str` in 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' format using a specific encoding scheme.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `url_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql

> SELECT url_decode('https%3A%2F%2Fspark.apache.org');
```
